title: refactor: pass agent configuration through metadata
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Passes metadata unchanged to endpoint agents on Chat Completions, Responses, and POST /text. Agents document and interpret their own keys.
- Removes agent_model and the custom model header handling. Uses ordinary body forwarding and cache keys, with no key allowlist or gateway model override.
- Updates Polli to read metadata.model and migrates both GitHub workflow callers. Documents the convention in Polli’s README.
- Tests: 199 gateway, 17 workflow, and 26 Polli API tests passed; Gen type-checking and formatting passed.
- Rollout: deploy the Polli update before switching the gateway/callers so the requested inner model continues to be honored.

gist.headline: Agents pack their own metadata
gist.blurb: Agent configuration now travels in the request metadata instead of hitching a ride through special gateway plumbing. Polli has learned the convention too, because apparently even bees appreciate fewer custom headers.
gist.summary: Chat Completions, Responses, and POST /text now forward agent metadata unchanged to endpoint agents, with Polli reading the requested inner model from metadata.model.
gist.impact: Agent builders can define and interpret their own metadata keys across all three text endpoints, while ordinary request forwarding and cache keys preserve the selected inner model without agent_model or a custom model header.
gist.visual_concept: Depict metadata as neatly labeled seed packets being delivered directly from API request envelopes to a cozy endpoint-agent garden, rather than routed through a tangle of special pipes. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, checks a packet labeled "metadata.model" beside a retro terminal while code-plants bloom around the agent garden.
